thread:
sam: heads up — CI on main is red, tools/checks failing. pre-commit step shows rustfmt + pyright + mypy errors. looks like something with pre-commit hooks cache.

ci-bot: build failed: tools/checks (ubuntu-latest) — pre-commit: rustfmt(1), pyright(1), mypy(1). logs: https://ci.example.com/build/742

anya: i'm grabbing logs now. if it's a cache mismatch that'd explain rustfmt differences. @jordan did you touch pre-commit config recently?

jordan: yeah i bumped pre-commit and refreshed a couple hooks in #repo-tools yesterday — also changed PRECOMMIT_CACHE_TTL in CI to 1h. didn't expect breaks but possible.

sam: when i run locally `pre-commit run --all-files` i get rustfmt no-op, but CI shows diffs in crates/kvcache/src/lib.rs. also pyright complaining about a new import in serve/runtime.

taylor: i've seen stale hook binaries cause this — CI can end up using a cached hook compiled against a different rustfmt. quick test: rerun with cache cleared.

mike: ok i'll trigger a rerun and force PRECOMMIT_CACHE=clear on the job.

ci-bot: @mike re-run initiated: tools/checks #742 (env PRECOMMIT_CACHE=clear)

jordan: note: the pyright error is `src/serve/runtime/__init__.py: error: Module 'serve.types' has no attribute 'RuntimeConfig'` — looks like a stubgen change in one of the hooks.

anya: plan: 1) rerun with cache clear (mike) 2) if still red, bisect pre-commit/config changes touching .pre-commit-config.yaml from last 5 commits. who can bisect?

mike: rerun finished — still red. excerpt from CI:
```
pyright: src/serve/runtime/__init__.py: error: Module 'serve.types' has no attribute 'RuntimeConfig'
pre-commit: rustfmt would change 1 file
```

sam: this is blocking a small stack of PRs. @jordan can you run git bisect across the recent pre-commit changes? if not i can pick it up but want to avoid more queue time.

jordan: starting bisect now across commits touching .pre-commit-config.yaml, ETA ~10m.

(10m later)

jordan: bisect result: commit 8f3a2b1 (hook upgrades + pin adjustments) introduced the pyright mismatch. immediate fix: revert the pin for `pyright` and regenerate stubs. opened PR #3387 to revert the specific change and added a short test to run stubgen in CI.

anya: nice catch. can we merge the revert + run full CI before unblocking merges? i'll hold merges until we get green.

mike: running full pipeline on revert PR now.

ci-bot: run result: full pipeline passed for PR #3387 — all checks green.

sam: :tada: merged revert and unblocked main. will follow up with a short postmortem in #eng and a note to avoid changing PRECOMMIT_CACHE_TTL until we have a cache rotation plan.

taylor: +1 on a follow-up. maybe add a small smoke job that clears cache and runs pre-commit in the matrix to catch this earlier.

mike: thanks everyone for the quick triage.
